{{Top}}
[[File:Cloud_City.jpg|thumb|right|225px|The [[Life Zone/Legends|Life Zone]] was part of Bespin's atmosphere that was made up of oxygen]]
{{Quote|Relax, and you can breathe. This symbiote filters oxygen from the sea. It can last for weeks under water.|Cilghal|<ref name="DA">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>}}
'''Oxygen''' ('''O'''),<ref name="SoL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref> also known as '''oxy''',<ref name="Shadows of the Empire">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> was the elemental gas that many beings breathed to survive, most notably [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. Such [[Species/Legends|species]] used [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] to take in the nourishing gas. It was, however, poisonous to [[Celegian/Legends|Celegians]], [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]], [[Gand/Legends|Gand]], and various other species. Oxygen was found on many inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Moon/Legends|moons]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was highly reactive, considered a reducing agent.<ref name="SoL" /> Oxygen was present as oxides in [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]],<ref name="Before the Storm">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref> and was vital to the creation of [[Silica/Legends|silica]] by bonding with [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]].<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

Most forms of life relied upon oxygen compounds for respiration. Oxygen released energy when exposed to certain enzymatic agents, and organisms utilized this energy in their metabolic processes. Oxygen was also a component of [[Water/Legends|water]], which few organisms could exist without.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>

The [[Fabrennix Oxygen Extractor]] was a device that was often used to extract oxygen from underground water as well as water vapor sources. Using a meter-long probe, it dug into the surface of a planet in order to collect individual molecules of water so that its operator would have enough to drink.<ref name="Galladinium's Fantastic Technology">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] also used [[Oxygen Symbiote]]s in order to breathe underwater. These symbiotes were able to filter pure oxygen from water, transferring it into the operator's lungs through their mouth and nose.<ref name="Dark Apprentice novel">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>

{{Science-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In real life, '''oxygen ''' ([[Wikipedia:International Phonetic Alphabet|IPA]]: /ˈɒksidʒən/) is a [[Wikipedia:chemical element|chemical element]] with the chemical symbol '''O''' and [[Wikipedia:atomic number|atomic number]] 8. On Earth it is usually bonded to other elements [[Wikipedia:Covalent bond|covalently]] or [[Wikipedia:ionic bond|ionically]]. The abundance of significant amounts of free oxygen in Earth's atmosphere is thought to be the effect of millions of years of plant life processes.
